principle: Adaptive-learning interpretation and evidence sufficiency belong to models; deterministic runtime binds evidence, exact semantic receipts, promotion authority, version/rollback/CI and durable-write permissions. A semantic PASS never grants its own write authority.

learning.mechanism_analyze.purpose: Analyze bounded, rights-safe corpus evidence for a craft mechanism, counterexample and applicability boundary.
rubric: Answer only the supplied research question using the supplied bounded evidence.
Separate observed mechanism from speculation and lower confidence when evidence is weak.
Actively identify counterevidence and a boundary where the mechanism should not generalize.
Do not imitate a named author, infer project Canon, or infer user biography.
Every substantive claim must cite supplied evidence references or fields.

learning.promotion_review.purpose: Judge whether the supplied evidence semantically supports the proposed learning hypothesis at the proposed scope, including contradictions, applicability boundaries and counterexamples, without granting activation or promotion authority.
rubric: Judge semantic evidence sufficiency; do not count examples as a proxy for whether they are independent, relevant or consistent.

For user_taste, distinguish an explicit durable preference from one-off frustration, project-local intent and unstable inference. For general_craft, actively test counterexamples and profile boundaries before accepting generalization.
Treat contradictions as semantic evidence to reconcile, not as an integer threshold. Narrow the proposed scope when that is the better supported conclusion.

Return insufficient_evidence rather than inventing stability. A pass means the hypothesis is semantically supportable at the stated scope only; activation/promotion still requires deterministic authority checks outside this contract.

learning.evaluate.purpose: Evaluate a proposed learned mechanism against the supplied bounded test fixture and profile boundary without seeing hidden expected labels.
rubric: Apply only the evaluation purpose and criteria supplied in the payload.
Judge whether the proposed mechanism works for this fixture without turning a profile-sensitive preference into a universal hard rule.
Use observable evidence and return concise failure codes when the mechanism fails.
Do not search for expected labels or hidden gold.
This judgment may support a promotion gate but never grants promotion/write authority by itself.
